title: How did I just stumble into this group?
content: I got chills reading some of the other posts in here because of how similar the themes are to a “world” I’ve dreamt about for years. Like several of you, my Mall World is not a mall, but a pre-WWII skyscraper that seems like it was a luxury hotel at one time. The building is about 30 stories high, vaguely art deco in style (lots of marble and brass and velour), and overlooks what seems to be an apocalyptic version of the Hudson River and Manhattan that my mind made up. The building has no accessible front door because the street below is flooded by the river and the first floor is full of sandbags to keep the water out. The center of the building is a square spiral of stairs going all the way up to the top floor, where I have an apartment that is accessible through an unassuming door. The layout doesn’t make sense and the apartment would have to be partially connected to the adjacent building. The hotel is in a long row of similar skyscrapers that are built into a cliff side. So while they are about 30 stories high in front, in back they appear only about 4 stories tall, with iron zigzag fire escapes. The building next to it has a secret bar on top that is full of people who can’t seem to see me. It is accessible via a scaffolding-like catwalk and is tucked into a part of the building that looks to have been somewhat demolished at one point, so it is partially open-air at one end. The apartment is kind of creepy. I’m always working on renovating it during these dreams. The layout seems like a normal pre-war apartment until you get to the staircase in the back that leads up to a yellow room with a high ceiling and a padded floor (like a wrestling mat). The windows are all very dirty and I cannot clean them. This room has an ominous feeling that the rest of the apartment doesn’t really have. There is another staircase that leads to a tiny alcove bedroom and a third one that goes to the roof of the slightly taller building next to it, where I’ve pieced together that it is on top of the weird bar where nobody can see me. Anyway, I dream of this place all the time and I’ve found it so interesting reading about these other intricate dream worlds. I’ve ventured outside of the building in dreams before but can’t recall why or how.
